sentences.2.2 Jeg kom til Norge i mai: 2.2 I came to Norway in May
Håvard meets Yousef and Leyla in the town centre.
sentences.Hei, Leyla. Hyggelig å hilse på deg. Når: Hi, Leyla. Nice to meet you. When did you come to Norway?
I came to Norway in May 2015.
sentences.Hvordan går det i Norge?: How are things going in Norway?
sentences.Bare bra, takk! Nå jobber jeg i en barne: Just fine, thanks! I work in a kindergarten now.
How nice, congratulations on the job.
sentences.Håvard, hva betyr «Hvordan går det». Vi: Håvard, what does "Hvordan går det" mean? We're not walking now.
It means "Hvordan har du det", how are you.
Oh, now I understand. We're doing just fine.
sentences.Yousef og Leyla bor i Risveien nummer 22: Yousef and Leyla live at Risveien number 22.
They are married and have three children.
Yousef came to Norway in October.
He came to Norway in August.
She came to Norway in March 2017.
She lives with a Norwegian family.

sentences.Han er skilt og har to barn på fire og s: He is divorced and has two children aged four and seven.
